text: Thanks. Let's go upstairs. I'll show you my room.
I love your dollhouse. It's amazing. Did you make it yourself?
Really? Is it hard to build one?
Not really. All you need is some cardboard and glue. Then just use a bit of creativity. What do you do in your free time?
That's rather unusual. Not many people do that.
Actually, it's more common than you think. There are some horse-riding clubs in Ha Noi now. I go to the Riders' Club every Sunday.
I'd love to go to your club this Sunday. I want to learn how to ride.
Sure. My lesson starts at 8 a.m.
